# NeuromorphicDetectionBackbone

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A spiking neural network architecture that serves as the detection backbone, outputting spike-based bounding box or objectness signals without converting to analog values. Keeps the entire tracking pipeline in the spike domain, enabling direct integration into in-network neuromorphic accelerators for low-latency, low-power operation.
